definition.name: young_diagram
definition.definition: A Young diagram (or partition) lambda = (lambda_1, lambda_2, ..., lambda_k) of n (written lambda |- n) is a weakly decreasing sequence of positive integers summing to n. It is drawn as a left-justified array of boxes with lambda_i boxes in row i. The number of nonzero parts is ell(lambda) (the number of rows). A standard Young tableau (SYT) of shape lambda is a filling of the boxes with the numbers 1,...,n such that entries increase along rows (left to right) and down columns (top to bottom). The number of SYTs of shape lambda equals dim(lambda), the dimension of the corresponding Specht module.
